{{Quote|Please, don't bore me with questions of politics. What do I care about politics? In my line of work, every cause is a just cause. Now, if you would just sign on the dotted line, the 5,000 blaster rifles will be yours&hellip;|Prengahl Kreen|<ref name="HaR" />}}
'''Prengahl Kreen''' was a wily [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] operating in the [[Empartheca system/Legends|Empartheca system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] hidden base [[Breshkall]] was his refuge, and it housed his family and friends. At some point in his life, he dealt with the [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunter]] [[Jakke Clamont]].

==Biography==
[[File:Jakke.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Prengahl Kreen dealt with Jakke Clamont (pictured).]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the third-generation [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Prengahl Kreen was one of the most successful [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]] in the [[Empartheca system/Legends|Empartheca system]],<ref name="HaR" /> located in the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> He had numerous contacts and hundreds of important [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and used this network for help in running down his desired [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. Kreen used the location [[Breshkall]],<ref name="HaR" /> an Outer Rim site in the [[Khuiumin sector/Legends|Khuiumin sector]],<ref name="EAOC2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Breshkall system/Legends|Breshkall system]]</ref> as a small hidden base that housed his family, friends, servants, and trusted associates. He did not conduct business at his refuge and visitors were not welcomed to it.<ref name="HaR" />

At some point, Kreen dealt with the [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunter]] [[Jakke Clamont]] and presented him with a large [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] new to the hunter. In another instance while dealing with an individual, he sidestepped the topic of politics and directed the individual to sign off on the sale of 5,000 [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].<ref name="HaR" />

==Personality and traits==
Kreen had a reputation for not backing down on his contracts, even if the costs or danger were higher than expected. He claimed that he could acquire any type of weapon wanted and his network appeared to bolster his statement. The wily Twi'lek also stubbornly supported the idea that he did not deal with the Rebel Alliance, though it was rumored he did deal with secondary individuals who did. Naturally, the hierarchy of the Alliance never dismissed the allegations.<ref name="HaR" />

==Skills and abilities==
Kreen was a hard and skilled bargainer who also conned and persuaded. The street-smart Twi'lek was educated on the business of arms-dealing, value and [[Economics/Legends|economics]], and [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He had some skill in searching and dodging in combat and used his<ref name="HaR" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> head-[[Limb/Legends|tails]] for secret communication with other Twi'leks.<ref name="HaR" />

An arms merchant, he could operate blasters, [[blaster artillery]], archaic guns, automatic weapons, and [[Missile/Legends|missile]]-based weapons. He also knew how to use blasters on vehicles, such as [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] gunnery. Kreen could repair starship weapons, blasters, and repair and program computers.<ref name="HaR" />

==Equipment==
Kreen wore a tailored business [[Clothing/Legends|suit]], had a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and armed himself with a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="HaR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prengahl Kreen was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Heroes & Rogues]], published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. The illustration of the character was done by artist [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="HaR" />
